description: Intent i010 (SNAPSHOT=s03, branch xsk-umem-rereads) complete. FINDING: include/net/xdp_sock_drv.h:284-309 xsk_tx_metadata_request() is a variant of the seed's TOCTOU mechanism. Untrusted source: struct xsk_tx_metadata resides in the userspace-mapped, concurrently writable AF_XDP UMEM buffer (meta = data - pool->tx_metadata_len). Validated-vs-used invariant violation: the only validated fetch of meta->flags is a single READ_ONCE in xsk_buff_valid_tx_metadata() (xdp_sock_drv.h:266, rejecting unknown bits and checking tx_metadata_len vs offsetofend(request.launch_time)); xsk_tx_metadata_request() then re-reads meta->flags directly and non-atomically FOUR times (lines 294, 299, 303, 307), each gating a distinct offload decision, so a racing userspace writer can set/clear bits after validation (e.g. pass validation with only TIMESTAMP, then set CHECKSUM so the unvalidated line-303 read triggers tmo_request_checksum(), or clear TIMESTAMP relative to the validated copy affecting line 307's pmeta=NULL logic feeding xsk_tx_metadata_to_compl()). Additionally meta->request.csum_start/csum_offset are passed to driver callbacks with NO READ_ONCE snapshot and NO bounds check against desc->len anywhere in the ZC path, unlike the fixed net/xdp/xsk.c:xsk_skb_metadata() (READ_ONCE locals + csum_start+csum_offset+sizeof(__sum16)<=desc->len, xsk.c:980-985, seed fix present in s03). Concrete call sites verified: include/net/libeth/xsk.h:215 __libeth_xsk_xmit_fill_buf_md (via xp_raw_get_ctx, net/xdp/xsk_buff_pool.c:774), mlx5 core/en/xdp.c:508,656, igc_main.c:3085 (launch_time re-read drives igc_tx_ctxtdesc), stmmac_main.c:2751/2765. SAFE classifications: xsk_skb_metadata itself (fix applied), xskq_cons_read_desc/read_desc_batch (single by-value descriptor snapshot, validated copy is the used copy), xsk_destruct_skb (uses cached kernel-private completion copy). Counterevidence/limitation: both in-tree tmo_request_checksum callbacks (mlx5, libeth) ignore the csum values, so no concrete OOB with existing callbacks is proven; impact is driver-dependent, hence medium confidence. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i010.json; checkpoint: agent-state/checkpoints/i010.json.
